integrity: The classification is a direct proof from the published admissibility and multiplication rules. The two involutions of the infinite cyclic group are exhausted, the fixed-point condition on the central parameter is checked, and the identity-involution branch is reduced exactly by Smith normal form; no finite experiment is used as proof.
limitations: The theorem classifies generalized Chein doubles only when the base group is infinite cyclic. It does not assert a criterion for other abelian or nonabelian just-infinite groups. Absolute literature novelty cannot be certified by finite search.
title: A parity classification of just-infinite generalized Chein doubles over the infinite cyclic group
